CLOSE ATTEMPT CORRECTION — the first attempt failed on MY ref choice, not on missing work.

I closed with --ref c1b96e05bd8, which is 03b0's OWN commit in the epic stack. The three unmet
criteria are all 'Delegated to child 7b22', and 7b22's implementation lands LATER in the stack
(position 3 counting from the tip; 03b0 is position 10). Measured:

  KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES in src/rebar/llm/config.py
    at c1b96e05bd8 (03b0's commit, the ref I passed) -> 0 occurrences
    at 443eb7cd1a6 (7b22's commit)                   -> 2 occurrences
    at the stack tip                                 -> 2 occurrences

So the verifier was correct about the tree it was shown: at that ref the shape-based
_PROVIDER_QUALIFIER_RE is still in place and KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES does not exist. Delegated
criteria cannot be verified against a ref that predates the delegate's commit.

Re-closing against the stack tip so the verifier sees 7b22's landed work. Child 7b22 is CLOSED
(completion-verifier attestation signed) and its change is Gerrit 1211 at LLM-Review +1 / Verified +1.
